deploybot: Created tag v1.8.3-rc2 for staging

 deploybot: tag: v1.8.3-rc2
 commit: 9f8a7e2
 author: release-manager
 changelog:
 - Fix: memory leak in cache eviction on long sequences
 - Perf: reduce KV cache copy in runtime (roughly 10% CPU improvement)
 - Ops: add fallback to cpu-quantized variant when GPU OOM

 celeste: Nice. Is this the hotfix we discussed for prod pinning? :eyes:
 owen: Yes — scheduling a staging canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC. If green, we'll pin to prod.
 marta: QA will run the regression suite after canary. I'll attach results here.
 ryan: Tagging command I used:
 ```
 git tag -a v1.8.3-rc2 9f8a7e2 -m "staging hotfix"
 git push origin v1.8.3-rc2
 ```
 celeste: @oncall can you approve a short change window for prod pinning? Need approval before 05:00 UTC.
 sre-bot: Change window request submitted: 05:00-05:30 UTC. ETA: 20m. Approvals: none yet.
 celeste: Please add a clear rollback plan pointing at v1.8.2; ops should be able to pin back quickly.
 ryan: Rollback plan: pin dedicated nodes back to v1.8.2, update routing-policy. I'll post exact commands in runbook.
 qa-bot: Regression run queued: job/qa-regress-1855. Will post pass/fail here.
 celeste: Thanks — waiting on canary metrics (latency, error rate, memory) before greenlight. :hourglass:
 deploybot: Release tag v1.8.3-rc2 pushed to staging registry. Canary monitors scheduled.
 celeste: :thumbsup:
